cases.brief: Create an English one-page website for DEMO ONLY Daniel Reed, a fictional keynote speaker for conferences, summits and company events. The supplied fictional portrait is approved for this design demonstration. The offer: keynotes of 20 to 60 minutes, on stage or live online, and a workshop on the same day if discussed. Three talk topics: How teams make decisions; Working through uncertainty; Turning ideas into experiments. Each topic needs a short accurate explanation, no invented outcomes. The main action is to explore the talks. The page should introduce the person and help an organiser choose a topic. Contemporary, clear and confident. Do not invent employers, past clients, publications, reviews, audience counts or a booking calendar. No enquiry form or personal contact details.

assets.subject: Approved fictional demo portrait: dark curly-haired man in a navy jacket on a slate-blue background, head and upper torso, 4:5

cases.brief: Create an English one-page website for DEMO ONLY Clay Table, a fictional pottery workshop. A supplied original illustrative photograph shows three hand-built white ceramic vessels on a cool pale surface with blue linen; it is approved as an example of the workshop's fictional sample objects. The main offer is a two-hour hand-building session for beginners at £45. A private group session can be discussed, with no confirmed price or dates. The beginner session has three parts: get to know the clay, form a simple vessel, choose a finish. The main action leads to beginner-session details. Give the objects and their tactile surface a meaningful role. Welcoming, contemporary and material-led; no forced beige or rustic stereotype. Do not invent premises, staff, availability, reviews or guarantees. No enquiry form or checkout.

assets.subject: Approved illustrative demo still life: off-white hand-built bowl, vase and handled cup on a cool grey surface with cobalt linen, natural side light, landscape 3:2

cases.brief: Create an English one-page site for DEMO ONLY Sheet Practice, a fictional independent spreadsheet consultant. No photos, logo or interface screenshots are available. Two services: spreadsheet cleanup (consistent names and dates, identification of duplicate rows), and workflow prototypes (a small working example for a repeated task, followed by a discussion before implementation). The visitor should understand which service fits and read the workflow. The main action leads to service explanations. A real workflow has three steps: discuss a sample, review an example, decide what to implement. Precise, contemporary and technically clear. An original abstract vector diagram may explain those relationships if useful. Do not invent dashboards, saved-hours figures, client results, testimonials, fees, contact details or tools used. No enquiry form or checkout.

Create an English one-page site for DEMO ONLY Night Current, a fictional independent music listening evening. The programme is a listening session at 7:30pm followed by a live trio set at 8:30pm; entry for the evening is £12. The main visitor task is to read the programme and practical times, with the main action leading to the programme. Intimate, music-led and expressive, with an independent cultural identity and clear practical information. No photographs, logo or recordings are supplied. An original abstract graphic may express the relationship between listening and a live set if useful. Do not invent performers, a date, venue, address, contact information, reviews, capacity or availability. No checkout or enquiry form. Do not prescribe a particular font, palette or hero composition.

imagePlan.purpose: Представить спикера как человека, не занимая половину экрана

imagePlan.subject: Три белых керамических сосуда на холодной поверхности с кобальтовым льном, иллюстративный демонстрационный кадр
imagePlan.purpose: Показать предметы и их тактильную поверхность как главный визуальный материал и задать палитру
imagePlan.placement: Широкое фото на всю ширину под заголовком и кнопкой; на телефоне текст и кнопка идут раньше фото
imagePlan.focalPoint: Группа сосудов в центре кадра, поверхность и складки льна

imagePlan.subject: Иллюстративный натюрморт: белые миска, ваза и чашка с ручкой ручной лепки на холодной серой поверхности с кобальтовым льном.
imagePlan.purpose: Показать результат занятия и фактуру глины как главный визуальный предмет страницы.
imagePlan.placement: Под заголовком и кнопкой на всю ширину; на телефоне после текста и кнопки.
imagePlan.focalPoint: Три сосуда в центре и их края с бликом бокового света

imagePlan.subject: Абстрактная таблица со строками и колонками, две одинаковые строки выделены акцентным цветом

imagePlan.subject: Абстрактная сетка таблицы, две строки подсвечены синим как возможные дубликаты, стрелка ведёт к маленькому прямоугольнику с линиями, обозначающему рабочий пример.
imagePlan.purpose: Показать связь: сначала порядок в данных, затем небольшой пример для повторяющейся задачи.
imagePlan.placement: Справа от заголовка на десктопе, под кнопкой на телефоне.

imagePlan.subject: Будущее настоящее фото зала во время прослушивания, если вечер состоится
